stages.label: 3D tile WFC
stages.description: Fill the lattice with platforms, stairs, arcades and pillars by Wave Function Collapse; gravity is part of the adjacency.
operations: WFC collapsed a 6 x 5 x 6 lattice in 61 attempt(s)
37 platform tiles, 7 stair tiles; kept the best of 19 solutions, whose socket graph scores 29 (reachable tiles, stairs weighted)

stages.label: Pillars, blocks and arcades
stages.description: Raise the load-bearing tiles: pillars, solid blocks and arcade frames.

stages.label: Platforms and stairs
stages.description: Lay the platforms and cut the stairs; each stair rises one level across one tile onto the platform beyond.
operations: 44 platform and stair tiles laid; entrance on the south platform

stages.label: Constraint checks
stages.description: Walk the labyrinth from the entrance on the voxels; fragments that cannot be reached are kept as ornament. Find every apparent join of the isometric view.

stages.label: Architectural detailing
stages.description: Potted trees and lanterns on platforms, lamps on pillars.

programs.source:
sequence detailing
  prl finials steps=1
    rule finial "T E E" -> "* V *" p=0.035 sym=none   # potted trees on platform tiles
  prl lanterns steps=1
    rule lantern "T E" -> "* l" p=0.030 sym=none
